item.title: Unlock the full potential of your Galaxy S26 with Spigen’s MagFit ecosystem
item.description: The Galaxy S26 looks and feels pretty similar to previous phones in the series, so if you’re upgrading this year, Spigen’s complete ecosystem of accessories will make your phone feel truly new on day one. With nearly 20 years of industry leadership, Spigen has built a case and MagFit ecosystem trusted by millions worldwide, solidifying its position as the go-to brand for Galaxy. more…

item.title: The RAM shortage is causing a smartphone ‘crisis like no other,’ market could shrink 13%
item.description: We’re only about four months into an ongoing memory crisis across the globe, but we’re already seeing some massive consequences spawning from this AI-driven demand. As expected, those very same consequences are coming for the smartphone market, with one firm expecting 160 million fewer sales compared to 2025. more…
